behavior.arguments: rcx = slot-array pointer; rdx = second-argument pointer (input); rdi = output-byte pointer. The window reads a kind byte and a 16-byte slot selected by ([rcx] == 0), overwrites the slot's link field from a two-hop pointer load, zeroes the slot, then restores conditionally by kind, and stores tag byte 5 at [rdi] on every path.
behavior.entry_shape: No endbr64, two forward branches, no calls: mov %rdi,%rax; mov 0xd8(%rdx),%r8; xor %r9d,%r9d; cmpq $0x0,(%rcx); sete %r9b; shl $0x4,%r9d; movzbl 0x40(%rcx,%r9,1),%esi; lea (%rcx,%r9,1),%rdx; add $0x30,%rdx; movups 0x30(%rcx,%r9,1),%xmm0; mov 0x30(%rcx,%r9,1),%rdi; mov 0x238(%r8),%r8; mov %r8,0x28(%rcx,%r9,1); xorps %xmm1,%xmm1; movups %xmm1,0x30(%rcx,%r9,1); lea -0x10(%rsi),%ecx; cmp $0x6,%ecx; jae 0x3290186; mov %rdi,(%rdx); movb $0x5,(%rax); ret; cmp $0x4,%esi; ja 0x3290182; movups %xmm0,(%rdx); movb $0x5,(%rax); ret.
behavior.return_rule: No return-value contract is claimed: rax holds the original rdi (the output-byte pointer) at every ret. The observable effects are: link field [rcx+r9+0x28] always overwritten with [[rdx-input+0xd8]+0x238]; the 16-byte slot at [rcx+r9+0x30] zeroed, then restored fully iff kind <= 4, restored in its first qword only iff kind in [16..21], left zeroed otherwise; output byte [rdi] = 5 on every path.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; zero sites found. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: Thirty R_X86_64_RELATIVE records in .rela.dyn name this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries). They are reported as a slot list only; no meaning is claimed for the table they belong to.
